detail.longDescription: I made this website to be an environment for graduated recall practice and testing of programming fluency with various languages/tools. I write a lot less manual code these days, but I don't like being too reliant on agents to do everything for me; I like to keep my fluency with some of the languages / tools I value the most. So this website helps me practice in those languages and retain and build my fluency. Hoping it might help others who feel similarly do the same.
